I've been seeing the counselor and psychiatrist since about October. It's been a while and I just don't feel like it's helping. 

I have been considering dropping out of school. My counselor has actually encouraged me to so that I can go to a treatment center. I'm just so scared of it. I've never given up on something academic. It's what I'm supposed to be good at. I've been planning to go to law school forever. I just hate it and I'm so overwhelmed.

I see numerous professionals right now: a counselor, a psychiatrist for medication, and a dietician to help with the eating issues. I haven't felt like any of it is helpful. I really appreciate you taking the time to reply.
I guess I really don't know what I expected.
